tree.approach: Endpoint-locality: a functor out of the codiscrete category K(S) is a trivial iso-system that collapses to a single object; the reusable engine of the liftings-≅-Cat completeness proofs.

children.approach: K(S) := codiscrete/chaotic category on S: Hom a b = PUnit, unique arrow per ordered pair; all SmallCat laws hold by PUnit definitional eta (rfl). Under DCont≅Cat this is deltaDC S (state comonad), already lean-verified in StateComonad.

(1) F : K(S) → C sends every morphism to an isomorphism: inverse of F.map(a→b) is F.map(b→a), triangles reduce to F.map_id since the round trip a→b→a is the identity in K(S). Witnessing forward map is literally F.map f.

(2) The endpoint iso-system ι a b : F.obj a ≅ F.obj b is coherent: ι a a = C.id (endpointIso_refl) and ι a b ⬝ ι b c = ι a c (endpointIso_comp), both from functoriality of F on the unique arrows of K(S). This is the 'trivial holonomy' datum.

(3) Payoff: every F.obj a is isomorphic to a single chosen object F.obj a₀; the classification factoring through K(S) collapses to one category, π₀(K(S))=1. Specialised to S=Bool (StateProductLifting stateProduct=ΔBool×ℤ/2): the two states are canonically isomorphic.
